exposure: Birthweight centile customized by maternal height
Birthweight centile customized by maternal height and weight
finding: Women with an infant classified as AGA on population centiles but LGA when customized for height are at increased risk of intrapartum cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women with infants considered large for gestational age (LGA) only when customized for maternal height are at increased risk of intrapartum cesarean section.
